title: Late-Fee Amount on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The late fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the greater of the class's flat late-fee floor and the class's late-fee percentage of the agreement's contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent, half up, and never more than the class's late-fee ceiling. It is posted against the unpaid period's rent charge, with that period's due date.

## The quantities

- **Percentage amount** — the class's late-fee percentage multiplied by the contracted monthly rent on the agreement, rounded to the cent, half up, once.
- **Floor** — the class's flat late-fee floor.
- **Ceiling** — the class's late-fee ceiling.
- **Late fee** — the greater of the percentage amount and the floor; where that greater figure exceeds the ceiling, the ceiling.

The class figures are those of the agreement's unit class on the class late-charge schedule. The contracted monthly rent is the rent on the rental agreement record.

## Order of figuring

1. The contracted monthly rent multiplied by the class's late-fee percentage, rounded to the cent, half up, gives the percentage amount.
2. The greater of the percentage amount and the class's flat late-fee floor is kept.
3. That figure is capped at the class's late-fee ceiling.

## Worked figures (hypothetical class: 15% percentage, $25.00 floor, $55.00 ceiling)

| Contracted monthly rent | Percentage amount | Greater of amount and floor | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| $180.00 | $27.00 | $27.00 | $27.00 |
| $120.00 | $18.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 |
| $450.00 | $67.50 | $67.50 | $55.00 |
| $173.35 | $26.0025, rounded to $26.00 | $26.00 | $26.00 |

Where the percentage amount equals the floor, the late fee is that common figure.
